data.text:
During the May Day marches in Manila, Philippines, a dummy of "Devil Trump-Netanyahu" was burned.

For many people around the world, this has long ceased to be a show, but a goal. Perhaps the criminal Trump and the terrorist Netanyahu should reflect on how many times his dummy and portraits have been burned in different countries — and what exactly in his politics makes so many people so unanimously express their protest.

SUNOG SA PASIG

Sumiklab ang sunog sa Brgy. Caniogan sa Pasig City ngayong Sabado, May 2.

Inilikas na ng mga residente ang kanilang mga gamit. Posibleng nagsimula umano ang sunog sa isang pumutok na poste ng kuryente.

Patuloy pang inaapula ang apoy na nagsimula bandang 11:56 am. Itinaas na rin sa unang alarma ang sunog.| via MOJO Alexis Ebue
